message:
Fix crash when finishing a job and other bugs found in play-testing

- Completing a job, selling the house or switching catalog tabs freed the
  button that was being clicked, which could crash the game. UI lists are
  now cleared with remove_child + queue_free.
- After selling, the tablet could be closed and the sold house kept
  playing, saving its state into the next house. The SOLD screen now stays
  until Next House is pressed.
- Furniture could be placed on top of the player, trapping them.
- Wall items could be hung on window glass; now only on inside walls.
- Buttons and sliders no longer take keyboard focus, so Tab/Space/Enter
  can't trigger hidden buttons.
- New input-driven play-test (tools/playtest.gd), also run in CI.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_012qor1XSDfrkA93pWv9pRUE

Add CrazyGames web export, SDK bridge, rewarded ad offer and docs

- CrazyGames export preset: single-threaded web build with the SDK v3
  loaded in the head include and a CGBridge helper (init after body
  exists, queued loading/gameplay events, ad callbacks)
- Gameplay start/stop now follows the HUD state (menus, tablet, pause)
- Optional rewarded ad on the tablet for extra cash
- GitHub Actions workflow that runs the self-test and builds the web export
- README with controls, export steps and credits

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_012qor1XSDfrkA93pWv9pRUE

Build Home Flip Designer: a first-person house renovation game

Procedural house and yard, cleaning, painting, flooring and furniture
placement tools, seven renovation jobs plus selling the house, tablet and
catalog UI, saving, synthesized audio, generated textures, Kenney CC0
models and a CrazyGames SDK bridge. Includes dev tools for screenshots,
catalog thumbnails and an automated play-through self-test.
